title: RBACv2 SAML NameID edge-cases, backfill orchestration, and admin bailout runbook
creator: Lina Chen
description: Goal: Safely migrate orgs from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 with a focus on SAML NameID format edge-cases, deterministic backfill for historical resources, preserving and augmenting audit logs, and an 'admin bailout' emergency path that allows operators to revert auth routing with minimal customer disruption. This ticket owns the orchestration plan, test scenarios, runbook steps, and customer comms templates for org opt-in and forced cutover waves.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write enabled for 100% of API traffic in non-blocking mode for canary orgs
Backfill completed for canary orgs with zero resource-permission drift (reconciliation delta <= 0.1%)
Audit event schema preserved and augmented (old_event_id mapped to new_event_id) and verified in export samples
SAML NameID mapping script handles urn:oasis:names, persistent/unspecified/transient and fallback to email claim according to policy
Admin bailout (kill-switch) can be executed by on-call within 3 minutes and routes auth checks to RBAC v1 without data loss
Customer comms template approved by legal and support and scheduled pre-cutover and post-cutover notices
tasks: T1 - Implement NameID normalization library (owner: Diego Morales) - handle legacy NameID values, whitespace normalization, URL decoding, and fallback mappings
T2 - Build deterministic backfill job (owner: Priya Nair) - idempotent, resumable, rate-limited, with checkpoints per-org
T3 - Dual-write adapter (owner: Marco Alvarez) - non-blocking writes to v2 permission ledger with oplog markers
T4 - Audit bridge (owner: Asha Patel) - emit legacy_event_id -> rbacv2_event_id mapping and ship to audit S3 prefix for runbook validation
T5 - Admin bailout implementation (owner: Diego Morales) - API gateway flag, routing rule, telemetry tag, and automated rollback safety checks
T6 - Canary orchestration (owner: Lina Chen) - select 5 low-latency median orgs + 2 high-traffic orgs for staged waves
T7 - Synthetic canaries and end-to-end tests (owner: QA Team) - permission checks, SSO flows, console admin actions, and edge-case SAML assertions
T8 - Observability dashboards and alerting (owner: Marco Alvarez) - permission-mismatch rate, dual-write lag, backfill progress, audit export verification panel
T9 - Customer comms and opt-in flow (owner: Support) - publish opt-in form, scheduled notices, revert instructions
T10 - Security review and threat model update (owner: Security Team) - ensure no escalation path introduced and bailout requires MFA+approver
rollout_plan: Phase 0: dry-run in staging with synthetic tenants and injected NameID variations. Phase 1: enable dual-write for 5 canary orgs, run backfill at 10% throughput, validate audits and run reconciliation. Phase 2: expand to 25% of staged orgs; perform customer opt-in wave and monitor for 48h. Phase 3: scheduled cutover waves with per-wave health checks; enable automatic fallback policies for persistent regressions. Final: full cutover with documented migration report and postmortem.
monitoring_checks: Permission-mismatch rate (v1 vs v2) < 0.5% for 24h before expanding wave
Dual-write write-success ratio >= 99.9% and avg dual-write latency < 150ms
Audit bridge completeness: sampled events show 1:1 mapping for last 10k events
SAML SSO errors (NameID mapping failures) < 0.1% of auth attempts
rollback_plan: Primary rollback: flip gateway routing to RBAC v1 (admin bailout) and pause backfill jobs. Secondary: replay v2 events to a holding bucket and mark as 'reconcile-later'. Rollback safety checks: require two-person approval (on-call + security lead), verify that dual-write stones are consistent, and publish customer notice within 30 minutes.
comm_template:
Pre-cutover notice: 'We will be migrating your organization's access control system to a new RBAC backend to improve reliability and auditability. During the window we'll run checks and may request SSO mapping details. If you opted in you'll see no disruption; otherwise contact support to schedule. For critical admin access please verify SAML NameID mapping in Console > SSO settings.'
Post-cutover success: 'Migration to RBACv2 completed for your org. Audit logs for the migration are available at [link]. Report anomalies to security@redwood.com with subject 'RBACv2 Migration - <org>'.

2026-03-06 - Asha Patel: Audit bridge prototype emits new_event_id and legacy_event_id; sampling consumer validated mapping for 50k events in test cluster.
2026-03-08 - Security Team: Reviewed threat model; admin bailout requires MFA and an approver and will be logged to an immutable audit stream.
2026-03-10 - Lina Chen: Canary orgs selected and informed; scheduled first dual-write enablement 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC. Support playbook drafted.
